title: Replace an OptiSweep Operator Station Tipper (LOTO, disconnect power/Ethernet/air, remove and reinstall)
summary: Safely replace a failed/replaced OptiSweep operator station tipper by performing LOTO, disconnecting the tipper’s power (6-pin Molex), Ethernet (ClearLink controller), and air line (quick disconnect), removing the old tipper from the sub-plate, installing the new tipper onto the existing sub-plate, reconnecting conduit/power/air/Ethernet, and restarting the operator station.
when_to_use: Use when an OptiSweep operator station tipper must be removed and replaced, requiring LOTO and physical disconnection/reconnection of the tipper’s power (6-pin Molex), Ethernet (ClearLink controller), and air line (quick disconnect), followed by reinstall and operator station restart.
roles_and_responsibilities: Operator: performs LOTO and all physical disconnect/reconnect and mechanical removal/installation steps on the OptiSweep operator station tipper.
safety_notes: Perform LOTO on the tipper before disconnecting power/air/Ethernet.
Use PPE: safety glasses and gloves.
access_or_tools_needed: Physical access to the OptiSweep operator station tipper
Tools: 3/8-in. wrench or socket (if needed to remove nine (9) self-tapping securing screws for the station side panel)
Tools: hex head screwdriver/socket for the four (4) hex head screws holding the tipper to the sub-plate

access_required: Physical access to the OptiSweep operator station tipper
system_preconditions: Tipper is ready for LOTO (LOTO method referenced as "Operator Station Lockout/Tagout" on page 2).

visual_references.description: ClearLink (CLINK) controller removal/connection view used to support unplugging Ethernet from the ClearLink controller and accessing the controller box.
Pneumatic valve assembly view supporting the air line/quick disconnect area and side panel access context for tipper station maintenance.
Tip cable view supporting tipper-side cable routing context (used as visual support for tipper cabling access).
Operator station HMI screen used during tipper commissioning (includes navigation to "Visu_MDs" (F2) and notes about maintenance/admin login).

steps.title: Perform LOTO on the tipper
steps.purpose: Ensure the tipper is safely locked out before any disconnection of power, Ethernet, or air.
steps.instruction: Perform LOTO on the tipper using the method referenced as "Operator Station Lockout/Tagout".
steps.expected_result: The tipper is in a locked-out state prior to disconnecting the control box and tipper connections.
steps.healthy_condition: LOTO is completed and verified before proceeding to disconnect power (6-pin Molex), Ethernet, and air line.
steps.failure_condition: You attempt to disconnect power/air/Ethernet without completing LOTO.

actions.label: Apply LOTO to tipper
actions.exact_action: LOTO the tipper (see "Operator Station Lockout/Tagout" on page 2).

stop_or_escalate_if: Stop and escalate if you cannot complete LOTO for the tipper before disconnecting power/air/Ethernet.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: 7.3.22.1: REMOVAL step 1: "LOTO the tipper (see \"Operator Station Lockout/Tagout\" on page 2)."

steps.title: Remove the station side panel (if necessary) to access the motor
steps.purpose: Provide access to the motor/control box area for disconnecting power and Ethernet and for removing the tipper.
steps.instruction: If necessary, use a 3/8-in. wrench or socket to remove the nine (9) self-tapping securing screws for the station side panel, then remove the station side panel to access the motor.
steps.expected_result: Station side panel is removed (when needed) and the motor area is accessible.
steps.healthy_condition: Nine (9) self-tapping securing screws are removed and the side panel is removed without damaging fasteners or surrounding components.
steps.failure_condition: Side panel cannot be removed due to inability to remove the nine (9) self-tapping securing screws.

actions.label: Check if side panel removal is needed
actions.exact_action: If necessary, use a 3/8-in. wrench or socket to remove the nine (9) self-tapping securing the side panel then remove the station side panel to access the motor.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: 7.3.22.1: REMOVAL step 2: "If necessary, use a 3/8-in. wrench or socket to remove the nine (9) self-tapping securing the side panel then remove the station side panel to access the motor."

steps.title: Disconnect tipper power (6-pin Molex) at the control box and route cable into the column
steps.purpose: Remove electrical power connection to the tipper safely before further disassembly.
steps.instruction: Remove the control box and disconnect the power cable from the tipper (6-pin Molex connector), then push the cable into the column.
steps.expected_result: 6-pin Molex power cable is disconnected from the tipper and the cable is pushed into the column.
steps.healthy_condition: Power cable is fully unplugged from the tipper’s 6-pin Molex connector and is routed into the column (not left hanging at the tipper).
steps.failure_condition: Power cable cannot be disconnected from the 6-pin Molex connector or cannot be routed into the column.

actions.label: Disconnect 6-pin Molex power
actions.exact_action: Remove the control box and disconnect the power cable from the tipper (6-pin Molex connector), then push the cable into the column.

stop_or_escalate_if: Stop and escalate if you cannot complete LOTO for the tipper before disconnecting power/air/Ethernet.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: 7.3.22.1: REMOVAL step 3: "Remove the control box and disconnect the power cable (6-pin Molex connector) and push the cable into the column."

steps.title: Unplug Ethernet from the ClearLink controller and route into the column
steps.purpose: Remove network connection to the tipper safely before removing the tipper from the sub-plate.
steps.instruction: Unplug the Ethernet cable from the ClearLink controller and push the Ethernet cable into the column.
steps.expected_result: Ethernet cable is unplugged from the ClearLink controller and routed into the column.
steps.healthy_condition: Ethernet connector is fully unplugged and cable is routed into the column (not left connected to the tipper).
steps.failure_condition: Ethernet cable cannot be unplugged from the ClearLink controller or cannot be routed into the column.

actions.label: Unplug Ethernet from ClearLink controller
actions.exact_action: Unplug the Ethernet cable from the ClearLink controller and push the Ethernet cable into the column.

stop_or_escalate_if: Stop and escalate if you cannot complete LOTO for the tipper before disconnecting power/air/Ethernet.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: 7.3.22.1: REMOVAL step 4: "Unplug the Ethernet cable from the ClearLink controller and push into the column."

steps.title: Disconnect air line at the quick disconnect (leave quick disconnect on tipper side)
steps.purpose: Safely disconnect pneumatic supply to the tipper while preserving the specified quick disconnect side for reassembly.
steps.instruction: Disconnect the air line at the quick disconnect at the bottom of the column, leaving the quick disconnect with the tipper side of the air line.
steps.expected_result: Air line is disconnected at the quick disconnect, with the quick disconnect remaining on the tipper side of the air line.
steps.healthy_condition: Quick disconnect is left on the tipper side as specified; air line is separated without damage to fittings.
steps.failure_condition: Quick disconnect cannot be left on the tipper side as specified.

actions.label: Disconnect air line at quick disconnect
actions.exact_action: Disconnect the air line at the quick disconnect at the bottom of the column, leaving the quick disconnect with the Tipper side of the air line.

stop_or_escalate_if: Stop and escalate if the air line quick disconnect cannot be left on the tipper side as specified.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: 7.3.22.1: REMOVAL step 5: "Disconnect the air line at the quick disconnect at the bottom of the column, leaving the quick disconnect with the Tipper side of the air line."

steps.title: Tape air line and quick disconnect to prevent debris entry
steps.purpose: Prevent debris from entering either side of the air line during disconnection.
steps.instruction: Add tape over the air line and quick disconnect to prevent debris from entering either side of the air line.
steps.expected_result: Tape is applied over the air line and quick disconnect on both sides to block debris entry.
steps.healthy_condition: Both exposed air-line/quick-disconnect openings are covered with tape.
steps.failure_condition: Debris protection (tape) cannot be applied to both sides.

actions.label: Apply tape for debris protection
actions.exact_action: Add tape over the air line and quick disconnect to prevent debris from entering either side of the air line.

stop_or_escalate_if: Stop and escalate if the air line quick disconnect cannot be left on the tipper side as specified or if debris protection (tape) cannot be applied to both sides.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: 7.3.22.1: REMOVAL step 6: "Add tape over the air line and quick disconnect to prevent debris from entering either side of the air line."

steps.title: Fully disconnect conduit bringing power, air, and Ethernet to the column and free cables from the tipper
steps.purpose: Remove all remaining connections so the tipper can be lifted off the sub-plate.
steps.instruction: Fully disconnect the conduit bringing power, air, and Ethernet to the column and pull these cables free from the tipper.
steps.expected_result: Conduit is disconnected and power/air/Ethernet cables are free from the tipper.
steps.healthy_condition: No remaining electrical or pneumatic connections hold the tipper to the column/conduit.
steps.failure_condition: Cables/conduit cannot be fully disconnected or remain attached to the tipper.

actions.label: Disconnect conduit and free cables
actions.exact_action: Fully disconnect the conduit bringing power, air, and Ethernet to the column and pull these cables free from the Tipper.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: 7.3.22.1: REMOVAL step 7: "Fully disconnect the conduit bringing power, air, and Ethernet to the column and pull these cables free from the Tipper."

steps.title: Optional: remove gripper and counter-balance weights
steps.purpose: Reduce mechanical complexity/imbalance during tipper removal (optional but recommended).
steps.instruction: Optional but recommended: remove the gripper (see "Gripper Replacement" on page 97) and the counter-balance weights (see "Counter-balance weights" on page 95).
steps.expected_result: Gripper and counter-balance weights are removed if you choose to follow the optional recommendation.
steps.healthy_condition: Mechanical components are removed without leaving the system in an unsafe or unstable state for the subsequent tipper removal.
steps.failure_condition: You cannot remove the gripper and/or counter-balance weights as needed to proceed safely.

actions.label: Remove gripper and counter-balance weights (optional)
actions.exact_action: Optional but recommended: Remove the gripper (see "Gripper Replacement" on page 97) and the counter-balance weights (see "Counter-balance weights" on page 95).

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: 7.3.22.1: REMOVAL step 8: "Optional but recommended: Remove the gripper ... and the counter-balance weights ..."

steps.title: Remove the old tipper from the sub-plate
steps.purpose: Detach the failed/old tipper from the sub-plate so the new tipper can be installed.
steps.instruction: With the tipper supported, remove the four (4) hex head screws holding the tipper to the sub-plate.
steps.expected_result: Four (4) hex head screws are removed and the old tipper is free from the sub-plate.
steps.healthy_condition: Tipper remains properly supported while screws are removed; tipper can be lifted off without binding.
steps.failure_condition: Four hex head screws cannot be removed/installed while the tipper is properly supported.

actions.label: Remove tipper mounting screws
actions.exact_action: With the tipper supported, remove the four (4) hex head screws holding the tipper to the sub-plate.

stop_or_escalate_if: Stop and escalate if the four hex head screws cannot be removed/installed while the tipper is properly supported.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: 7.3.22.1: REMOVAL step 9: "With the tipper supported, remove the four (4) hex head screws holding the tipper to the sub- plate."

steps.title: Install the new tipper onto the existing sub-plate
steps.purpose: Reinstall the replacement tipper on the same sub-plate mounting interface.
steps.instruction: Install the new tipper onto the existing sub-plate.
steps.expected_result: New tipper is positioned on the existing sub-plate mounting interface.
steps.healthy_condition: Tipper sits correctly on the sub-plate such that mounting screws can be installed.
steps.failure_condition: New tipper cannot be installed onto the sub-plate or mounting screws cannot be installed.

actions.label: Mount new tipper
actions.exact_action: Install the new tipper onto the existing sub-plate.

stop_or_escalate_if: Stop and escalate if the four hex head screws cannot be removed/installed while the tipper is properly supported.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: 7.3.22.2: INSTALLATION step 1: "Install the new tipper onto the existing sub-plate."

steps.instruction: Connect the conduit, power, air, and Ethernet to the column and control box.
steps.expected_result: Conduit/power/air/Ethernet are reconnected to the column and control box.
steps.healthy_condition: All reconnections are made to the specified interfaces (column and control box) so the station can be restarted.
steps.failure_condition: Any required reconnection cannot be completed (power/air/Ethernet/conduit).

steps.instruction: Mount the gripper, if necessary (see "Gripper Replacement" on page 97).
steps.expected_result: Gripper is mounted if it was removed.
steps.healthy_condition: Gripper is installed and secured per the referenced gripper replacement procedure.

steps.instruction: Reinstall the top and/or bottom side panels, if necessary.

success_criteria: Old tipper is removed from the sub-plate after disconnecting power (6-pin Molex), Ethernet (ClearLink controller), and air (quick disconnect).
New tipper is installed on the existing sub-plate.
Conduit/power/air/Ethernet are reconnected to the column and control box.
healthy_conditions: LOTO is completed before disconnecting power/air/Ethernet.
Ethernet is unplugged from the ClearLink controller and routed into the column.
Air line is disconnected at the quick disconnect with the quick disconnect left on the tipper side, and both sides are protected with tape.
Tipper mounting screws are removed/installed while the tipper is properly supported.
Operator station restart is completed after reassembly.
failure_conditions: LOTO cannot be completed before disconnecting power/air/Ethernet.
Air line quick disconnect cannot be left on the tipper side as specified.
Debris protection (tape) cannot be applied to both sides of the air line/quick disconnect.
Four hex head screws cannot be removed/installed while the tipper is properly supported.
Operator station cannot be restarted after replacement.
escalation_guidance: If any stop condition is met (LOTO not possible, air quick disconnect side cannot be preserved, debris protection cannot be applied, or mounting screws cannot be removed/installed while supported), stop work and escalate rather than proceeding with disassembly/reassembly.

source_refs.quote_or_summary: Section 7.3.22: Tipper Replacement. Includes LOTO, optional side panel removal (nine self-tapping screws), disconnect power (6-pin Molex), unplug Ethernet from ClearLink controller, disconnect air line at quick disconnect, tape to prevent debris, remove four hex head screws from sub-plate, install new tipper, reconnect conduit/power/air/Ethernet, reinstall panels, and restart operator station.
